Pintu Kumar @ Pintu Mistri vs The State Of Bihar on 8 January,
2025

Author: Prabhat Kumar Singh
Bench: Prabhat Kumar Singh
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.55818 of 2024
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-293 Year-2021 Thana- Shekhpura Complaint
 District- Sheikhpura
 ======================================================
 1. Pintu Kumar @ Pintu Mistri Son of Ram Chandra Sharma R/O Heganpura,
 P.S.- Noorsarai, Dist.- Nalanda.
 2. Runi Kumari D/O Ram Chandra Sharma R/O Heganpura, P.S.- Noorsarai,
 Dist.- Nalanda.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. The State Of Bihar
 2. Neha Bharti Wife of Pintu Mistri R/O Heganpura, P.S.- Noorsarai, Dist
 Nalanda Hal Mokam, D/O Uma Shanka Prasad Sharma Gram Payeen, P.S.-
 Sheikhpura, Dist.- Sheikhpura.

Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ram Babu, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Vinod Shanker Modi, APP  Mr. Dinkar Kumar, Adv.

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4. 08-01-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.P.P. for the State and learned counsel for opposite party no. 2.
2.

The petitioners apprehend their arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 323,
342, 498A, 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 6 & 67 of the I.T.Act.
3.

At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the dispute between the parties has been settled amicably through the process of mediation and petitioner no. 1 & opposite party no. 2 have agreed to live together, as husband and wife.
Petitioner no. 1 also undertakes to keep opposite party no. 2 with full respect and dignity.

4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the aforesaid contention and confirms the fact Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.55818 of 2024(4) dt.08-01-2025 regarding the Pintu Kumar @ Pintu Mistri vs The State Of Bihar on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75935044/
1 settlement entered into between the parties.
5.

entities.text: Pintu Kumar @ Pintu Mistri vs The State Of Bihar on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Here, it is relevant to mention that earlier, with consent of the parties, the matter was referred to Mediation & Conciliation Centre of Patna High Court to explore the possibility of settlement between the parties, which has been resolved in terms of Memorandum of Agreement annexed with Mediator's report.

entities.text: Mediation & Conciliation Centre of Patna High Court
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 6. In view of aforesaid facts and circumstances, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of eight weeks from today, let the petitioners, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M. 1st Class, Sheikhpura in connection with Complaint Case No. 293 (C) of 2021, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure with condition that petitioner shall abide by all the terms & conditions, mentioned in Memorandum of Agreement, failing which, the learned Court below would be at liberty to cancel the bail-bond of petitioner."

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J)
